name: Kate Harriet
occupation: Did not take office as Johnson County clerk after winning the November 2022 general election (withdrew before the January 2023 start of the term, as reported by Sheridan Media)
background: Kate Harriet won the November 2022 general election for Johnson County clerk but did not take office. Sheridan Media reported on November 16, 2022, that Commissioner Bill Novotny said the commission had received a letter from her announcing her intent to withdraw, and that the withdrawal was due to health issues. The same outlet later reported that commissioners appointed Jackie Camino in December 2022 to fill the office.

sources.name: Sheridan Media, Nov. 16, 2022, Harriet Declines Elected Office of Johnson County Clerk
Sheridan Media, Dec. 6, 2022, Commissioners Select Camino for Clerk
